utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any new updates yet, but I’ll ask around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. I appreciate you checking around—let me know what you find.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you bring a hammer and some duct tape? That should cover the basics.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can bring a hammer and duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d want to double-check the timing and who’s bringing what before we count on it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, let’s confirm it before we count on it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was just about to ask what you still need fixed. I can help if you’ve got a list going.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a small list started: a few tools, some screws, and a working flashlight would help a lot. If you can grab any of that, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I can do that — tools, screws, and a flashlight. I might forget a thing or two, so if you see me wander off, just remind me!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the details of the repair drive first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I haven’t sorted the details yet. I’ll check and send them over soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — I’ll wait for the details before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries at all — it’s going pretty well so far, just a steady stream of drop-offs. We’re still looking for a few more handy folks if you know anyone who can help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I might be able to bring someone by later, or I can help for an hour if you still need hands.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you lend a drill and a couple screwdrivers for the repair drive? I’ll make sure they get back to you right after.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I can lend those over for the repair drive. Just bring them back when you’re done.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet—where’s the repair drive being held?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s at the community center by the park—right after school pickup, around 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — community center by the park at 3:30. I’ll head over after school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right — the repair drive. I haven’t heard any fresh updates yet, but I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I see anything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. If you hear anything, send it my way and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything. We’ll keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Rey, are we still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Mina, yes — I’m still on for it today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time should I swing by?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate that. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it — I’ll let folks know and pass along any updates I hear.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive moving. I’ll help keep everything organized and make sure folks know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I appreciate you keeping it organized — I can help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Uli — could you help me track donations and check in with volunteers? I’ll keep the list tidy and make sure everyone stays in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a pretty good turnout already. If you need the details, I can ask around and pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be kind of you, Tess. If you hear anything, please let me know—I like having the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing, Eli—I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if I hear the latest on it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — it’s going well, and I’ve been repeating the plan to folks so everyone stays on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Glad to hear it — what still needs doing, and where can I jump in?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m listening—what’s the repair drive focusing on first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly the porch steps and the busted fence, if we can manage it. I’d be grateful for any help, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. Do you want me to bring tools, or just show up and lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a bit swamped, but tell me what you need and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo — I’m just trying to pin down where the repair drive is happening. If you know the location, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I don’t have the location handy, sorry — can you send me the details again?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what part do you want to tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules. First, can we confirm what needs fixing most urgently and what tools or supplies we already have?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — let’s make a quick priority list first, then we can check our tools and supplies against it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a bit behind, but I’m listening now; what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — could you help sort the donated tools and keep an eye on the sign-in table? I’ll handle the rest and let you know if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I can sort the tools and watch the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. If you spot anything useful, just let me know and I’ll swing by.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m heading out now, so I’ll tell you if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great—can you help sort the donated items and keep the tools in one spot? That’d make things much easier.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I’ll sort the donated items and keep the tools together in one spot.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I want to make sure the schedule and drop-off details are clear first. Can you tell me when the repair drive starts and where we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It starts Saturday at 9 a.m., and we’re meeting at the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — I’ll plan for Saturday at 9 and head to the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’ve been meaning to tell everyone — the repair drive’s happening soon, and you should come by! I’ll send you the details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an eye out for the details and see what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll pass along the details as soon as I get them. If you think of anything you can bring, let me know!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can swing by after school drop-off and help coordinate the repair drive. What still needs to be done?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Faye — that would be a huge help. I’m a little scattered, but I think we still need to confirm the tools list and get a couple more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can take the tools list and start asking a couple parents about volunteering after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted. Let’s figure out the first homes we should check.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ve been hearing bits and pieces, so I’d appreciate the updates. I can help check on the first homes if you tell me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — let’s start with the homes on Maple and then work our way down Cedar. I’ll send you the list and any notes I have so we can split it up.
